title: Pharmacotherapeutic potential of bilobetin to combat chromium induced hepatotoxicity via regulating TLR-4, Nrf-2/Keap-1, JAK1/STAT3 and NF-kappaB pathway: A pharmacokinetic and molecular dynamic approach.
authors: El Safadi, Mahmoud; Hayat, Muhammad Faisal; Akbar, Ali; Nisar, Abdullah; Alzahrani, Fuad M; Alzahrani, Khalid J
journal: Journal of trace elements in medicine and biology : organ of the Society for Minerals and Trace Elements (GMS)
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然黄酮bilobetin对铬致肝毒性的保护作用，涉及分子对接与动力学模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chromium (Cr) is one of the top-notch noxious heavy metals that is documented to exert deleterious effects on various body organs including the liver. Bilobetin (BLB) is a natural flavonoid which exhibits a wide range of medicinal properties. AIM: This trial was executed to investigate the pharmacotherapeutic potential of BLB to avert Cr instigated hepatotoxicity via modulating TLR4, JAK1/STAT3, Nrf-2/Keap-1 and NF-kappaB pathway. RESEARCH LAYOUT: Our trial was executed on thirty-six male albino rats that were segregated into four equal groups including the control, Cr (10 mg/kg), Cr (10 mg/kg) + BLB (12 mg/kg) and BLB (12 mg/kg) alone treated group. Various biochemical parameters were assessed by using qRT-PCR, molecular docking, molecular dynamic simulation and histological approaches. FINDINGS: Our results revealed that Cr administration significantly impaired the health of hepatic tissues by reducing the gene expression of Nrf-2 and its downregulating genes while promoting the levels of oxidative stress markers (ROS and MDA). Moreover, Cr administration upregulated the hepatic enzymes including ALT, GGT, AST, and ALP while concurrently decreasing the levels of total protein and albumin. Cr exposure also elevated the gene expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines including toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), high mobility group box 1 (HMGB1) nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB), Janus kinase 1 (JAK1), signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3), tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha), C-reactive proteins, interferon-gamma inducible protein-10 (IP-10), Interleukin beta-1(IL-1beta), monocyte chemoattractant protein-1 (MCP-1), interleukin-6 (IL-6) and cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2). Hepatic apoptosis was observed to be elevated following the Cr intoxication. Nonetheless, BLB treatment remarkably alleviated the hepatic damages via regulating the biochemical as well as histological profile of liver. Our findings are further endorsed by molecular docking analysis that demonstrated that BLB exhibit strong binding affinity to Keap-1 and STAT3 thus supporting its efficient hepatoprotective potential. CONCLUSION: BLB protected the hepatic tissues via regulating Cr induced impairments. These findings were confirmed by molecular docking and molecular dynamic simulation analysis.
abstract_zh: 背景：铬（Cr）是一种高毒性重金属，已被证实对包括肝脏在内的多种身体器官产生有害影响。双黄酮（Bilobetin, BLB）是一种天然黄酮类化合物，具有广泛的药用特性。目的：本试验旨在探讨BLB通过调节TLR4、JAK1/STAT3、Nrf-2/Keap-1及NF-kappaB通路来预防Cr诱导肝毒性的药理学潜力。研究设计：本试验以三十六只雄性白化大鼠为对象，将其分为四个等量组别，包括对照组、Cr（10 mg/kg）组、Cr（10 mg/kg）+ BLB（12 mg/kg）组及BLB（12 mg/kg）单独处理组。通过qRT-PCR、分子对接、分子动力学模拟及组织学方法评估了多种生化参数。结果：我们的结果显示，Cr给药通过降低Nrf-2及其下游调控基因的表达，同时促进氧化应激标志物（ROS和MDA）水平，显著损害了肝组织健康。此外，Cr给药上调了包括ALT、GGT、AST和ALP在内的肝酶水平，同时降低了总蛋白和白蛋白水平。Cr暴露还升高了促炎细胞因子的基因表达，包括toll样受体4（TLR4）、高迁移率族蛋白B1（HMGB1）、核因子kappa B（NF-kappaB）、Janus激酶1（JAK1）、信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）、肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-alpha）、C反应蛋白、干扰素γ诱导蛋白-10（IP-10）、白细胞介素β-1（IL-1beta）、单核细胞趋化蛋白-1（MCP-1）、白细胞介素-6（IL-6）及环氧合酶-2（COX-2）。Cr中毒后观察到肝细胞凋亡增加。然而，BLB治疗通过调节肝脏的生化及组织学特征，显著缓解了肝损伤。我们的发现进一步得到分子对接分析的支持，该分析表明BLB对Keap-1和STAT3表现出强结合亲和力，从而支持其有效的肝保护潜力。结论：BLB通过调节Cr诱导的损伤保护了肝组织。这些发现通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟分析得到确认。
